a.name: Flanked portrait
a.description: A tall London owner photo in the middle with three numbered, ruled points on each side, under a centred question and a steel rule.
a.differs_from: The photo stands inline between two text columns under rules; the built rows put it right of one column, above two, or leave it out on a band.

b.name: Offset block
b.description: The photo offset on a steel-100 block that bleeds off the left edge; the question, a label and value spec sheet and a brass pill right.
b.differs_from: Photo on the left on a block that bleeds to the page edge, with a spec sheet; S1 puts the image right in plain prose, S2 above, S3 has none.

c.name: Two chapters
c.description: A sunk steel-100 tray with two H3 chapters, Carlisle then London: heading rail, its own photo, then the prose that answers it.
c.differs_from: Two H3 chapters, each image straight after its heading in the text flow, in a sunk tray; no built row has H3 chapters or an inset frame.
